name: Sumeragi Riou
source:
2nd year student. Star Sign: Sagittarius.
Member of the Wind Instrument Club. He plays the saxophone.
He loves cute things and sweets.
He's not very good at concentrating for very long and he's always disappearing somewhere soon after practice begins.
